verdict.rationale: The evidence pack lists RustDesk's supported codecs (VP8/VP9/AV1, H264/H265) and a generic claim of '90+ options'. Neither documents adaptive quality under poor network conditions or user-set resolution and frame rate. A community mention of a 'shrink' view-scaling feature is adjacent and does not cover these capabilities, so the applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As a power user, quality adapts when the link falls behind, and I can set resolution and frame rate myself
